meta.title: Industries
meta.description: Deep expertise in education, finance and marketing technology, now extended with AI and automation, plus custom software for businesses across industries.

hero.title: Solutions for *Every Industry*
hero.text: Every industry runs differently. We design technology around the workflows, customers and regulations that make yours unique.

expertise.title: Where We Go *Deepest*
expertise.text: Three industries where we have built, shipped and run real products, not just client projects.

items.title: Education
items.text: We have built learning management systems and education management platforms covering courses, assessments, admissions, attendance, fees and reporting for institutes and training providers.

items.title: Finance
items.tagline: Built into our own product, TeckHub360
items.text: Our in-house platform TeckHub360 handles real financial workflows, so we know compliance, document processing, accurate calculations and secure client data from the inside.

items.title: Marketing
items.text: Landing pages, lead capture, CRM integrations, campaign automation and dashboards that show which channels actually drive revenue.

ai.title: Moving Into *AI & Automation*
paragraphs: The domain knowledge we built in education, finance and marketing now powers our AI and automation work. We know where the manual effort sits in these workflows, so we know where AI actually pays off.

Instead of bolting a chatbot onto a product, we add intelligence where it removes real work: reading documents, answering routine questions, and moving data between systems without anyone copying and pasting.

items.title: AI assistants
items.text: Tutors, support agents and internal helpers trained on your own content.

items.title: Document intelligence
items.text: OCR and extraction that turn forms, invoices and records into structured data.

items.title: Workflow automation
items.text: Hand-offs, reminders, approvals and reports that run on their own.

others.title: Other Industries *We Serve*
others.text: The same engineering approach adapts to the workflows of any business.

items.title: Retail & E-commerce
items.text: Online stores, inventory sync, loyalty programs and omnichannel customer experiences.

items.title: Healthcare & Wellness
items.text: Patient portals, booking systems and secure records workflows built for compliance.

items.title: Real Estate & Construction
items.text: Listing platforms, project tracking, approvals and field-to-office reporting.

items.title: Logistics & Distribution
items.text: Order tracking, dispatch tools and supply-chain automation.

items.title: Professional Services
items.text: Client portals, document workflows, scheduling and billing automation.

items.title: Manufacturing
items.text: Production dashboards, quality tracking and ERP integrations.

items.title: Non-Profit & Associations
items.text: Membership management, donations and community platforms.

cta.title: Don't See Your Industry?
cta.text: We've built solutions for businesses of every shape. Tell us about yours and we'll show you what's possible.
